name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Jared Huffman running with large cash advantage
Republican challenger has minimal fundraising and no outside support
Prediction markets price Huffman near certain to win
model.rationale: Huffman holds a D+13 district with over $1 million on hand while Littau shows no reported fundraising, and markets price his win at roughly 97%. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, this stays safely Democratic.
model.watch: A surprise wave election or an unexpectedly funded challenger could narrow the margin, though a Huffman loss remains very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jared Huffman is seeking another term in a Northern California district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He enters the general election with roughly $1.1 million on hand after raising nearly $1 million, while Republican Robin Littau reports no fundraising totals and no outside spending on either side. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race.

Prediction markets give Huffman about a 97 percent chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals and the incumbent's financial edge. The forecast places this race firmly in the Safe Democratic category, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
